parsed.scene_description: An indoor lounge or library area with large windows on the left. A cylindrical spiral bookshelf stands near the window. In the center and right, there are orange armchairs around tables. A large screen displays a face. Stairs ascend to the right. The floor is reflective.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: Cylindrical structure with multiple horizontal shelves containing books. Located on the left side near large windows. Supported by a central column base.

objects.label: orange armchair
objects.observation: Curved orange upholstered chair with a five-star metal base. Positioned on the floor near tables. Multiple instances visible in the foreground and mid-ground.

objects.label: table
objects.observation: Round or oval table surface visible between chairs. Dark color. Positioned on the floor.

objects.label: large screen
objects.observation: Rectangular display showing a close-up of a face. Mounted on a wall structure in the center-right area.

objects.label: stairs
objects.observation: Set of steps with yellow lighting underneath. Ascending to the right side of the image. Appears to be a fixed architectural element.
